name: SDLC
description: Engineering practice run with the human rather than recited at them. The deliver loop agrees the outcome, the first decisions, a module map and the story list with the user, confirms each story's criteria as it starts, then runs it through failing tests, a build subagent, a three-pass review, the full suite and a pull request into main, asking each question as it arises and choosing each next story from what is ready. Around it: orient, story-map, story, next-story, test-plan, review-build, merge-request, spike, greenfield, give-feedback, guardrails, make-rule and adr. The user, not the model, makes every judgment call.
